findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_technical_page" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_papers, get_paper, list_technical_pages, get_technical_page, trace_connections, compare_technical_sections · Private data: explain_method · Public sink: start_strategy_link · Destructive: get_paper, explain_method, get_technical_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_papers, get_paper, list_technical_pages, get_technical_page, trace_connections, compare_technical_sections · Private data: explain_method · Public sink: start_strategy_link · Destructive: get_paper, explain_method, get_technical_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
